title: 人教版七年级上册期末综合检测

sections.title: 二、语法选择
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，按照句子结构的语法性和上下文连贯的要求，从各题所给的选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
There is a kind woman. She has a nice house [26] a big yard. In her yard, there [27] many flowers.

One day, Bill comes to her yard. What beautiful flowers! Bill thinks the woman has a happy life. Then he finds that the woman can't [28] anything.

"[29] do you plant these flowers here?" Bill asks.

The woman smiles and says, "First, I love flowers. Second, I can't see the flowers, but I can smell [30]. As for the last reason, it's for you."

"Me? [31] you don't know me."

"Yeah, I don't know you. But as I know, everyone [32] flowers. Many people stop in front of my yard every day. The [33] make them happy. The flowers also make me [34] with you here. They bring us great fun."

After reading the story, my dear students, what can you learn from [35] woman?

questions.translation: 她有一栋带着大院子的漂亮房子。
questions.explanation: 介词 default with 意为“带有；具有”，此处表示房子带有大院子。

questions.translation: 在她的院子里，有许多花。
questions.explanation: there be 句型遵循主谓一致与就近原则，主语 many flowers 为复数，故填 are。

questions.translation: 然后他发现这位妇女什么也看不见。
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can't 后面接动词原形 see。

questions.translation: “你为什么在这里种这些花？”比尔问。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“First... Second... As for the last reason...”可知比尔在询问原因，用疑问词 Why。

questions.translation: 第二，我看不见花朵，但我能闻到它们（的气味）。
questions.explanation: 动词 smell 后面需接人称代词宾格 them 指代前文的 flowers。

questions.translation: “我？但是你不认识我啊。”
questions.explanation: 此处表示语气转折，用连词 But。

questions.translation: 据我所知，每个人都喜欢花。
questions.explanation: 不定代词 everyone 作主语时，谓语动词用第三人称单数形式 likes。

questions.translation: 花朵使他们感到快乐。
questions.explanation: 此处作主语表示“这些花朵”，应用名词复数 flowers。

questions.translation: 花朵也让我在这里和你交谈。
questions.explanation: make sb. do sth. 为固定用法，意为“让某人做某事”，使用动词原形 talk。

questions.translation: 读完这个故事后，亲爱的同学们，你们从这位妇女身上学到了什么？
questions.explanation: 此处特指故事中的那位妇女，应用定冠词 the。

sections.title: 三、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从各题所给的选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Hello, I'm a 13-year-old English girl. My name is Martha Brown. Martha is my [36] name. I'm in Shanghai, China now. I go to a [37] next to my home. I like my school because my teachers and my classmates are friendly. There is a big library in my school and there are many [38]. I like reading there.

I'm [39] Class Three, Grade Seven. In our class, there are 27 students, 15 [40] and 12 boys. Ms. Sun is our [41] and she teaches us Chinese. What does she [42]? Well, she's tall. Her blue eyes are big and her face is round. She often [43] us study after class.

Our [44] is big and nice. There is a computer on the teacher's [45]. With the help of the computer, we can [46] many useful materials(有用的资料). My desk is yellow and my chair is [47] too. I like yellow. It's a nice [48]. Look! On my desk is my [49]. There is a red pen, a blue pen, an orange eraser, and two green pencils in it. Oh, these three rulers on the desk are [50] too.

Everything is OK here. I'm very happy to study here.

questions.translation: 玛莎是我的名字（教名）。
questions.explanation: 英文名字中 Martha 为名字(given name)，Brown 为姓氏(last name)。

questions.translation: 我去我家旁边的一所学校上学。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“I like my school”可知是在我家附近的学校(school)上学。

questions.translation: 学校里有一个大图书馆，里面有很多书。
questions.explanation: 图书馆(library)里自然是有许多书(books)，且后文提到喜欢在那里阅读。

questions.translation: 我在七年级三班。
questions.explanation: 表示“在某班级/年级”用介词 in。

questions.translation: 我们班有27名学生，15名女生和12名男生。
questions.explanation: 与后文 12 boys (男生) 相对，27 - 12 = 15 名女生(girls)。

questions.translation: 孙老师是我们的老师，她教我们语文。
questions.explanation: 根据“she teaches us Chinese”可知孙老师是老师(teacher)。

questions.translation: 她长什么样？
questions.explanation: 询问长相用“What does she look like?”。

questions.translation: 课后她经常帮助我们学习。
questions.explanation: help sb. (to) do sth. 意为“帮助某人做某事”。

questions.translation: 我们的教室又大又漂亮。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“teacher's desk”, “my desk”, “my chair”描述可知此处是指教室(classroom)。

questions.translation: 讲台上有一台电脑。
questions.explanation: teacher's desk 意为“讲台/教师桌”。

questions.translation: 在电脑的帮助下，我们可以找到许多有用的资料。
questions.explanation: 在网上查阅/找到(find)资料。

questions.translation: 我的课桌是黄色的，我的椅子也是黄色的。
questions.explanation: 后文紧接着说“I like yellow”，因此椅子也是黄色(yellow)。

questions.translation: 黄色是一种好看的颜色。
questions.explanation: yellow 属于颜色(colour)。

questions.translation: 看！在我的课桌上是我的文具盒。
questions.explanation: 后文提到里面有笔、橡皮、铅笔等，可知是文具盒(pencil box)。

questions.translation: 噢，桌上的这三把尺子也是我的。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文语境，表示“也是我的”，用名词性物主代词 mine。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 (Passage A)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列短文，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Do you know the homework club in our school? The students do their homework in the afternoon at the club. Why do we have the club? The students always play games and watch TV after school, so the homework club is a quiet place for them to do their homework. Teachers there can help them with their homework. After the students finish their homework, they can get a snack(点心). It's always children's favorite food. Do you want to know the time and fee? Let's have a look. | Item | Details | | :--- | :--- | | **Time** | Every session (一段时间) is four weeks, from Monday to Thursday. You can go to the club one to four days a week. The homework club is in the Bay Library.
★ Monday, Tuesday and Thursday: 3:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m.
★ Wednesday: 1:30 p.m. - 2:30 p.m. | | **Fee** | 4 days a week: $150/session
3 days a week: $125/session
2 days a week: $100/session
1 day a week: $75/session |

questions.prompt: 51. What may students get after they finish homework in the homework club?
questions.translation: 学生在作业俱乐部做完作业后可能会得到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文章“After the students finish their homework, they can get a snack... It's always children's favorite food.” 选项中只有 cake 属于点心(snack)。

questions.prompt: 52. If Jack is only free from 1:40 p.m. to 2:20 p.m., he can go to the club on ______
questions.translation: 如果杰克只在下午1:40到2:20有空，他可以在哪一天去俱乐部？
questions.explanation: 根据表格 Time 中“Wednesday: 1:30 p.m. - 2:30 p.m.”可知周三开放时间符合杰克的空闲时间。

questions.prompt: 53. The students go to the homework club because ______
questions.translation: 学生去作业俱乐部是因为______
questions.explanation: 根据文章“the homework club is a quiet place for them to do their homework.”可知他们需要一个安静的学习地方。
options: A. they want to help their teachers
B. they need a quiet place to study
C. they can play with their friends there
D. they can play games and watch TV there

questions.prompt: 54. The underlined word "fee" in Paragraph 1 means ______
questions.translation: 第一段中画线单词“fee”的意思是______
questions.explanation: 根据表格下文 $150, $125 等费用信息可知 fee 表示“费用”。

questions.prompt: 55. We can read this passage in a ______
questions.translation: 我们可以在哪里读到这篇短文？
questions.explanation: 文章介绍学校作业俱乐部，属于学校新闻或校园报纸(school newspaper)内容。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 (Passage B)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列短文，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
How do you go to school every day? By bus, by car or by bike? Anyway(无论如何), it must be easy for you to get to school. But for Lucia, it is very difficult. If she wants to go to school, she has to swim there.

Lucia lives in a small village in Western India. She is a student at a high school. There is a small river between her village and the school, but there is no bridge over the river. Some of the villagers go to work by boat. But Lucia's family doesn't have a boat, so she must swim across the river to go to school. Luckily, the river doesn't run fast.

Every day, Lucia gets up at a quarter past six in the morning. After breakfast, at a quarter to seven, she leaves home. She always takes some dry(干的)clothes and books in a plastic(塑料的)bag with her. When she crosses the river and gets to the other side, she puts on her dry clothes in a small room. Then she walks to school.

She needs too much time to get to school, but she likes to go to school. It's her dream to go to college(大学).

questions.prompt: 56. Where does Lucia live?
questions.translation: 露西娅住在哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据文章“Lucia lives in a small village in Western India.”可知她住在小村庄里。

questions.prompt: 57. What does the underlined word "Luckily" mean?
questions.translation: 画线单词“Luckily”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: Lucia 必须游过河去上学，幸好(Luckily)河水流得不快。

questions.prompt: 58. How does Lucia go to school?
questions.translation: 露西娅如何去上学？
questions.explanation: 文章讲述 Lucia 必须游泳渡河并拿着装衣服的塑料袋，到对岸换干衣服后再走路去学校，选项 C 完美符合该场景描述。
options: C. Swimming across the river with bags then walking

questions.prompt: 59. What is Lucia's dream?
questions.translation: 露西娅的梦想是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文章最后一句“It's her dream to go to college(大学).”可知她的梦想是上大学。
options: A. She wants to build a bridge.
B. She wants to have a boat.
C. She wants to study in a college.
D. She wants to be a swimming star.

questions.prompt: 60. From the story, we can know that ______
questions.translation: 从故事中我们可以得知______
questions.explanation: 根据全文描述，对 Lucia 来说去上学很艰难，但她非常热爱学习。
options: A. It's good to live in a small village.
B. Students often swim across the river to go to school.
C. Lucia seldom goes to school because her family doesn't have a boat.
D. It's difficult for Lucia to go to school, but she likes studying very much.

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 (Passage C)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列短文，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Hello, boys and girls! Do you like to make new friends at school? Yes? Here's some of my advice.

First, don't be shy! Try to talk to all of your classmates. Smile and say, "Hello! What's your name?" If you can't hear the name clearly, try to say "Sorry, can you repeat that for me, please?" Then give your name and say, "Nice to meet you!" It's really as simple as that! It's important to get people's names right. If you get them wrong, they might feel sad!

Second, ask questions! Ask about school, sport, or music! As you listen, think of more questions to ask. So when your classmate stops talking, you can ask another question and keep the conversation going! But remember, you have to be a good listener before you can ask good questions.

Lastly, don't forget to share! Tell your classmates something interesting about yourself. Then your new friends can get to know you too! Soon enough, you'll be good friends!

I hope you find my advice helpful! Now go to make some new friends!

questions.prompt: 61. What is the first piece of advice?
questions.translation: 第一条建议是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“First, don't be shy! Try to talk to all of your classmates...”可知第一条建议是不要害羞，要勇敢交流。

questions.prompt: 62. The missing part in the third paragraph is ______
questions.translation: 第三段中缺失的部分是______
questions.explanation: 第三段讲述“Ask about school... ask another question”，可知主题是提问(ask questions)。

questions.prompt: 63. How can you help your new friends get to know you better?
questions.translation: 你如何帮助新朋友更好地了解你？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段“Tell your classmates something interesting about yourself. Then your new friends can get to know you too!”可知是通过分享关于自己的趣事。
options: A. By listening to your classmates carefully.
B. By trying your best to remember their names.
C. By sharing something fun about yourself.
D. By asking them some questions about school.

questions.prompt: 64. Which shows the structure of the passage? (P = Paragraph)
questions.translation: 哪一项展示了文章的结构？（P代表段落）
questions.explanation: 文章 P1 总起提出建议，P2(First), P3(Second), P4(Lastly) 为三条并列建议，P5 总结并鼓励去交朋友，结构为 P1 -> P2, P3, P4 -> P5。

questions.prompt: 65. Why does the author write this text?
questions.translation: 作者写这篇文章的目的是什么？
questions.explanation: 通篇围绕给学生的交友建议展开，旨在教大家如何在学校结交新朋友。
options: A. To tell us the importance of true friendship.
B. To teach us how to make new friends at school.
C. To give some advice to know about new school.
D. To show that it is important for us to learn to share.

sections.title: 五、阅读表达
sections.instruction: 阅读下面的短文，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
China has a long history of over 5,000 years. What do you think is the symbol of China? Here are the answers of three students.

Di Xinran is eleven years old from Shenzhen. She thinks the Great Wall can represent(代表) China. It is about 21,100 kilometres long and has a history of over 2,000 years. The girl really wants to go to the Great Wall one day.

For Wang Jingqi, a 13-year-old boy, red can represent China. It is the main (主要的) colour of the national flag(国旗) of our country. We can often see red in our life. The colour is everywhere(到处) during the Spring Festival and some other festivals.

11-year-old Li Qinrui thinks dumplings can represent China. Most families in China make and eat dumplings during some important festivals. Everyone is very happy to make dumplings.

questions.prompt: 66. Are Di Xinran and Li Qinrui of the same age?
questions.translation: 狄欣然和李沁瑞同岁吗？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Di Xinran is eleven years old”和第四段“11-year-old Li Qinrui”可知两人都是11岁，是同岁的。

questions.prompt: 67. How old is the Great Wall?
questions.translation: 长城有多少年历史了？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“has a history of over 2,000 years”可知有2000多年历史了。

questions.prompt: 68. According to Wang Jingqi, what can represent China?
questions.translation: 根据王景齐的说法，什么可以代表中国？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“For Wang Jingqi... red can represent China.”可知是红色。

questions.prompt: 69. What do most families do during some important festivals?
questions.translation: 大多数家庭在一些重要节日做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段“Most families in China make and eat dumplings during some important festivals.”可知是包水饺和吃水饺。
options: A. Go to the Great Wall.

questions.prompt: 70. What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的主要内容是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章讲述三位学生关于什么可以作为中国象征和代表的看法。
options: A. The history of the Great Wall.
B. Three students' answers about what can represent China.
C. How Chinese people celebrate the Spring Festival.
D. The main colour of the national flag.

sections.title: 六、短文填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从方框中选择适当的词并用其正确形式填空，使短文通顺、意思完整。每空限填一词，每词限用一次。
sections.passage:
Dear Marcos,

Hi, my name is Rebecca and I am your new pen pal. I'm ten [71] old, and I live in Barcelona, Spain. I am [72] the fourth grade in Saint Michael School. On weekdays, I [73] up at 6 o'clock. The school begins at 7:30 in the morning. I have my lunch at school and I [74] go home at about 3:30 in the afternoon. I am good [75] Chinese, and I also like history and science very much, but English is my [76]. I like [77] basketball and soccer. I also play tennis, and I like swimming. On weekends, I go to the movies with my friends. We like action movies. [78] my parents have time, I go for a picnic with them.

Please write to me and tell me about you and your life. What's [79] family like? What do you like doing in your [80] time?

I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Yours,
Rebecca

questions.translation: 我今年十岁，住在西班牙巴塞罗那。
questions.explanation: 表示年龄几岁用 years old，名词 year 用复数 years。

questions.translation: 我在圣迈克尔学校读四年级。
questions.explanation: 表示“在四年级”用介词 in。

questions.translation: 在工作日，我6点起床。
questions.explanation: get up 意为“起床”，主语为 I，动词用原形 get。

questions.translation: 我在学校吃午饭，通常在下午 3:30 左右回家。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 go 用副词 usually（通常）。

questions.translation: 我擅长中文，我也非常喜欢历史和科学。
questions.explanation: be good at 意为“擅长……”。

questions.translation: 但英语是我的最爱。
questions.explanation: 名词 favourite 意为“最喜欢的事物/学科”。

questions.translation: 我喜欢打篮球和踢足球。
questions.explanation: like doing sth. 表示“喜欢做某事”，play 变为 v-ing 形式 playing。

questions.translation: 当我的父母有时间时，我和他们一起去野餐。
questions.explanation: 引导时间状语从句意为“当……时”，用连词 When（句首首字母大写）。

questions.translation: 你的家庭是什么样的？
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 family 用形容词性物主代词 your（你的）。

questions.translation: 你空闲时间喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: in one's free time 意为“在某人的空闲时间”。

sections.title: 七、补全对话
sections.instruction: 根据对话内容，从方框内选择恰当的句子将对话补充完整。（选项中有两项是多余的）
sections.passage:
**A:** How is your school life in junior high?
**B:** It is wonderful! I join two clubs—the photography club and the music club.
**A:** Wow! Sounds interesting! [81]
**B:** I go to the music club twice a week. I learn a lot there. [82]
**A:** Does anybody teach you there?
**B:** Yes. [83] She is very nice. Everyone likes her.
**A:** [84]
**B:** There are 15 students in the music club. We are good friends.
**A:** What about the photography club? [85]
**B:** We learn some photography skills to take better photos.
**A:** That's great!
wordbank: A. Which club do you join?
B. What do you do there?
C. Why do you join the club?
D. I can play the guitar very well now.
E. How many students are there in the music club?
F. Miss Chen is our teacher in the club.
G. How often do you go to the music club?

questions.translation: 你多久去一次音乐俱乐部？
questions.explanation: 回答“I go to the music club twice a week.”（我一周去两次），提问频率用 G. How often do you go to the music club?
questions.answer: G. How often do you go to the music club?

questions.translation: 我现在吉他弹得很好。
questions.explanation: 承接前句“I learn a lot there.”说明学习成果，选 D. I can play the guitar very well now.
questions.answer: D. I can play the guitar very well now.

questions.translation: 陈老师是我们在俱乐部的老师。
questions.explanation: 回答“Does anybody teach you there?”和后句“She is very nice.”，介绍老师选 F. Miss Chen is our teacher in the club.
questions.answer: F. Miss Chen is our teacher in the club.

questions.translation: 音乐俱乐部有多少学生？
questions.explanation: 回答“There are 15 students in the music club.”，提问人数选 E. How many students are there in the music club?
questions.answer: E. How many students are there in the music club?

questions.translation: 你在那里做什么？
questions.explanation: 回答“We learn some photography skills...”，提问活动内容选 B. What do you do there?
questions.answer: B. What do you do there?
